title: Employer and counselor default/legacy loaders still scan take:5000 rows
blast: First beat only measured dashboard + admin training-progress. Employer home legacy path (?ui=legacy, still shipped) runs a 9-query Promise.all including jobPostingApplication.findMany take:5000 and aIJobMatch.findMany take:5000. Employer jobs/pipeline/matches pages still take:5000 on the live path. Counselor legacy home takes 5000 assignments + 5000 threads + 5000 messages. Partner home does application.findMany take:5000 distinct userIds. Same pooler as /dashboard; concurrent employer+counselor staff will 504 the way members did.
evidence: app/(portal)/employer/page.tsx:56-60 comment admits 9-query Promise.all + take:5000 hired scan; :238 and :275 take:5000. app/(portal)/employer/jobs/page.tsx:63-75 take:5000 x3. app/(portal)/employer/pipeline/page.tsx:39,50 take:5000. app/(portal)/employer/matches/page.tsx:29,43 take:5000. app/(portal)/counselor/page.tsx:143-190 take:5000 x3 on legacy. app/(portal)/partner/page.tsx:568-569 take:5000. Kit default avoids some of this on employer/counselor home only; sibling pages do not.

title: Admin counselors kit hydrates 20k assignments unscoped on every load
blast: Default /admin/counselors (not ?ui=legacy) Promise.allSettled counselor.findMany take:500 + counselorAssignment.findMany take:20000 with member lastLoginAt. No organizationId. First beat cited training-progress 20k courseProgress only. This is a second 20k-row staff page sharing the pooler. Admin members/students/wioa-screening/users also take:5000 with no org filter.
evidence: app/admin/counselors/page.tsx:54 isAdmin only; :88-107 default kit loads counselors take:500 and assignments take:20000, no organizationId. app/admin/members/page.tsx:38 isAdmin; :58-60 whereClause has MEMBER_OR_DOGFOOD_WHERE but no organizationId (rg organizationId → 0). app/admin/placements/page.tsx:64 isAdmin; :69 findMany take:500 no org. app/admin/students/page.tsx:146 take:5000.

title: Unauthenticated WIOA voice session mints ElevenLabs URLs with fail-open limiter
blast: POST /api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session has no getUser. It rate-limits via checkPublicVoiceSessionRateLimit which returns {success:true} when Upstash is null (lib/rate-limit.ts:524-527). File prices voice at ~$0.30/min and 1k unbounded reqs ≈ $1.5-3k. This is not on TENANT_API_PATHS. First beat covered apply/AI/voice fail-open for authed tools; it missed the public no-account mint. CI and Vercel build set RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_MISSING_UPSTASH=1 so preview deploys run this open.
evidence: app/api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session/route.ts:22-55 POST, no getUser, startElevenLabsPortalSession('wioa_prequal'). lib/rate-limit.ts:86-88 cost comment; :524-527 fail-open. middleware.ts:75 TENANT_API_PATHS omits /api/public and /api/ai. .github/workflows/ci-gate.yml:32 RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_MISSING_UPSTASH=1.
verify: rg -n 'getUser' app/api/public/wioa-qualification/voice-session/route.ts; test $? -ne 0 && rg -n 'if \(!publicVoiceSessionRateLimiter\) return \{ success: true \}' lib/rate-limit.ts

title: withTenantScope is a no-op for PlacementRecord, CourseProgress, Application, messages
blast: makeScopedProxy returns the raw delegate when the model is not in TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS. WIOA report wraps placementRecord.count/aggregate and courseProgress.groupBy and user.findMany take:10000 inside withTenantScope and treats that as isolation. PlacementRecord and CourseProgress have no organizationId column (schema.prisma Application:384, PlacementRecord:1255, CourseProgress:1851). A second-org admin hitting a 'scoped' API still reads every placement/progress row. verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs asserts withTenantScope is called; it does not assert the model is in the set.
evidence: lib/tenant/scopeProxy.ts:45-60 TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS (user/partner/employer/job/course/courseEnrollment/catalog/screening/chapter*). :96-98 if !TENANT_SCOPED_MODELS.has(prop) return Reflect.get — pass-through. app/api/admin/reports/wioa/route.ts:26-56 withTenantScope then db.placementRecord / db.courseProgress / db.user.findMany take:10000. prisma/schema.prisma PlacementRecord has no organizationId. scripts/verify-high-risk-tenant-routes.cjs does not mention training-progress, placements/page, members/page, counselors.

title: Three cron paths send overlapping member inactivity emails plus B4B HTTP
blast: First beat found inactive-nudge vs inactivity-nudge. Deep pass: /api/cron/at-risk-alerts also runs runMemberRetentionNudges (lib/cron/at-risk-alerts.ts) which classifies active members with Prisma + Coursera/B4B HTTP in batches of 15 and sends check-in/come-back/stuck mail. vercel.json schedules at-risk-alerts daily 13:00 UTC, inactive-nudge Mon 10:00, inactivity-nudge Wed 10:00. Throttle reduces double-send; it does not reduce the triple scan or B4B fan-out on the same pooler as SSR.
evidence: vercel.json:11-12 at-risk-alerts; :47-51 both weekly nudges. app/api/cron/at-risk-alerts/route.ts:40-41 runDailyAtRiskCounselorAlerts + runMemberRetentionNudges. lib/cron/at-risk-alerts.ts:32-37 NUDGE_BATCH_SIZE=15 with B4B/Coursera HTTP per candidate.

title: Public /api/health opens a Prisma $transaction and Upstash ping on a 5s cache
blast: Unauthenticated GET /api/health (and ?deep=true) always hits checkPublicHealthRateLimit (fail-open) then, on cache miss, prisma.$transaction SELECT 1 plus Redis ping plus optional S3 HEAD. 5s process-local cache. Load-balancer / uptime probes from many IPs become extra pooler checkouts on the same isolate that serves /dashboard. Not in the first beat map.
evidence: app/api/health/route.ts:15 CACHE_TTL_MS=5000; :30-38 prisma.$transaction $queryRaw SELECT 1; :126-149 GET withApiGuc + fail-open health limiter + cache. lib/rate-limit.ts:546 checkPublicHealthRateLimit fail-open.

title: Any global isAdmin can mint CRON_SECRET and fire every cron including mailers
blast: POST /api/admin/email-crons/[id]/trigger uses requireAdmin (global) then fetch(origin + cron.apiPath) with x-cron-secret + Bearer CRON_SECRET from server env. A second-org admin can trigger partner-outcome-digest (take:2000*n), Coursera syncs, weekly-recap-email, data-cleanup. 60s timeout. Origin defaults to production www.workforceap.org if NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL unset — preview admin can fire production crons.
evidence: app/api/admin/email-crons/[id]/trigger/route.ts:18 requireAdmin; :26-50 CRON_SECRET forwarded; :34 origin = NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL ?? https://www.workforceap.org. lib/auth/roles.ts:103 requireAdmin → isAdmin() not isAdminInOrg.

title: 19 /api/ai routes plus leader/gdpr/subgroup have no middleware session backstop
blast: middleware TENANT_API_PATHS is only /api/member|/api/employer|/api/partner|/api/counselor. /api/ai (19 routes, ElevenLabs + LLM), /api/leader, /api/gdpr, /api/subgroup, /api/feature-flags, /api/mentors rely solely on per-route getUser(). Comment at middleware.ts:68-73 claims those four prefixes were audited 2026-07-01. A future AI route that forgets getUser() is a spend/PII hole with no edge 401. All current AI routes do call getUser(); this is a missing backstop, not a current IDOR.
evidence: middleware.ts:75 TENANT_API_PATHS. find app/api/ai -name route.ts → 19 files, each getUser(). app/api/gdpr/delete/route.ts:16 getUser only. app/api/leader/chapters/route.ts:10 getUser only. No isTenantApiPath for /api/ai.
